response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM g) AS diff_above_avg FROM g ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
